3.2.1.v: The affix अण् comes after a verbal root when the object (or whatever sort it may be), is in composition with it (an an उपपद).

3.2.2.v: The affix अण् comes after a root हूञ् 'to call' वेञ् 'to weave', माङ् 'to measure', when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.3.v: The affix क comes after a verbal root that ends in long आ when there is no उपसर्ग preceding it and when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.4.v: The affix क comes after the root स्था when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix, as an उपपद ।

3.2.5.v: The affix क comes after the verbs परिमृज् 'to wash out' and अपनुद् 'to drive away' when in composition with the words तुन्द 'navel' and शोक 'grief', as objects respectively.

3.2.6.v: The affix क comes after the root दा 'to give' and ज्ञ 'to know', when taking the preposition प्र in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.7.v: The affix क comes after root ख्या 'to tell', when preceded by the preposition सम् and when the object is in compsition with it.

3.2.8.v: The affix टक comes after the verbs गै 'to sing' and पा 'to drink' when used without a preposition and when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.9.v: The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् when it does not mean 'to raise up', when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.10.v: The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् when the object is in composition with it and when the meaning of the word to be formed is descriptive of age.

3.2.11.v: The affix अच् comes after the verb हृञ् (when the object is in composition with it) the root taking the preposition आङ् and the sense of the word to be formed in inclination or accustomed occupation.

3.2.12.v: The affix अच् comes after the verb अर्ह 'to respect', when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.13.v: The affix अच् comes after the verb रम् 'to sport' and जप् 'to whisper' when the case-inflected words स्तम्भ 'a clump of grass' and कर्ण 'ear' are in composition with them respectively.

3.2.14.v: The affix अच् is used after the verbal roots when शम् 'well' is in composition and the word to be formed denotes a name.

3.2.15.v: The affix अच् comes after the verb शी 'to lie down' when in composition with a case-inflected word indicating location i.e. in the Locative -7th-case.

3.2.16.v: The affix ट comes after the verb चर् 'to go' when a case-inflected word in composition with it denotes a location.

3.2.17.v: The affix ट is used after the verb चर् 'to go' when the words in composition with it भिक्षा 'alms', सेना 'army' and आदाय 'having taken'.

3.2.18.v: The affix ट comes after the verb सृ 'to move' when the words in composition with it are पुरः , अग्रतः and अग्रे , all meaning 'in front or before'.

3.2.19.v: The affix ट comes after the verb सृ 'to go' when पूर्व in composition with it, denoting the agent.

3.2.20.v: The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the object is in composition with it denoting cause, habit and going with the grain (concession).

3.2.21.v: The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the following words are in composition with it - 1. दिवा 'by day' 2. विभा 'light' 3. निशा 'night' 4. प्रभा 'splendour' 5. भाः 'light' 6. कार 'work' 7. अन्त 'end' 8. अनन्त 'endless' 9. आदि 'beginning' 10. बहु 'many' 11. नान्दी 'benediction' 12. किम् 'what' 13. लिपि 'writing' 14. लिबि 'writing' 15. बलि 'oblation' 16. भक्ति 'devotion' 17. कर्तृ 'agent' 18. चित्र 'painting' 19. क्षेत्र 'field' 20. संख्या - words denoting numerals 21. जङ्घा 'thigh' 22. बाहु 'hand' 23. अहः 'day' 24. यत् 'what' 25. तत् 'that' 26. धनुस् 'bow' 27. अरुस् 'wound'.

3.2.22.v: The affix ट comes after the verb कृञ् 'to make' when the word कर्म is in composition with it and the sense of the word to be formed is that of wages.

3.2.23.v: The affix ट does not come after the verb कृ 'to make' when the following words are in composition with it - 1. शब्द 'sound' 2. श्लोक 'verse' 3. कलह 'quarrel' 4. गाथा 'praise' 5. वैर 'enmity' 6. चाटु 'flattery' 7. सूत्र 'thread' 8. मन्त्र 'hymns' 9. पद 'word'.

3.2.24.v: The affix इन् comes after the verb कृ when the objects in composition with it are the words स्तम्ब 'a sheaf' and शकृत् 'ordure'.

3.2.25.v: When the agent indicated is an animal, the affix इन् comes after the verb हृ 'to take', the object in composition with it being the words ददृति 'a leather bag' and नाथ 'a master'.

3.2.26.v: And the words फलेग्रहि and आत्मम्भरि are irregularly formed.

3.2.27.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix इन् comes after the verbs वन् 'to honour', सन् 'to worship', रक्ष् 'to protect' and अथ् 'to agitate', when the object is in composition.

3.2.28.v: The affix खश् comes after the verb एजृ 'to tremble' when ending in शि and when the object is in composition with it.

3.2.29.v: The affix खश् comes after the verbs ध्मा 'to blow' and धे 'to suck' when नासिका 'nose' and स्तन 'breast' are in composition with them as object.

3.2.30.v: And when the words नाडी 'a tube' and मुष्टि 'a fist' are objects in composition with the verbs ध्मा 'to blow' and धे 'to suck', the affix खश् is used.

3.2.31.v: The affix खश् comes after the verbs रुजि 'to break into pieces' and वह् 'to carry', when preceded by the उपसर्ग उत् and the word कूल 'bank' is in composition with them as the object.

3.2.32.v: The affix खश् comes after the verb लिह 'to lick' when the object in composition with it, is the word वह 'the shoulder of an ox' or अभ्र 'a cloud'.

3.2.33.v: The affix खश् comes after the verb पच् 'to cook' when the object in composition with it denotes a measure.

3.2.34.v: The affix खश् is used after the verb पच् 'to cook' when मित 'a measured partition' or नख 'a nail' is the word in composition with it as an object.

3.2.35.v: The affix खश् comes after the verb तुद् 'to strike' when विधु 'the moon' or अरुस् 'a wound' is the word in composition with it as object.

3.2.36.v: The affix खश् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' and तप् 'to heat' when असूर्य and ललाट are the words in composition with it as object.

3.2.37.v: The words उग्रम्पश्य , इरम्मद , पाणिन्धम are irregularly formed.

3.2.38.v: The affix खच् comes after the verb वद् 'to speak' when प्रिय or वश is the word in composition with it as an object.

3.2.39.v: The affix खच् comes after the verb ताप् 'to heat' when द्विषत् or पर is the word in composition with it as an object.

3.2.40.v: The affix खच् comes after the verb यस् 'to curb' when the word वाक् 'speech' is in composition with it as an object and the sense indicated is that of a vow.

3.2.41.v: The affix खच् comes after the verb दारि 'to split' and सह् 'to bear' when respectively in composition with the words पुर् 'a city' and सर्व 'all', as objects.

3.2.42.v: The affix खच् comes after the verb कष् 'to rub' when the words सर्व 'all', कूल 'bank', अभ्र 'cloud' and करीष 'a dry cow-dung' are in composition with it as objects.

3.2.43.v: The affix खच् comes after the verb कृ 'to make' when the words मेघ 'cloud' अर्ति 'misfortune' and भय 'fear' are in composition as objects.

3.2.44.v: And the affix अण् as well as खच् come after the verb कृ 'to make' when the words क्षेम 'happiness', प्रिय 'pleasant' and भद्र 'joy' are in composition as objects.

3.2.45.v: The affix खच् comes after the verb भू 'to be' when in composition with the case-inflected word आशित 'satisfied by eating' and the sense is that of instrument or condition.

3.2.46.v: The affix खच् comes after the verbs - 1. भृ 'to bear' 2. तॄ 'to cross over' 3. वृ 'to choose' 4. जि 'to conquer' 5. धारि 'to hold' 6. सहि 'to bear' 7. तपि 'to heat' 8. दम 'to subdue'

3.2.47.v: And the affix खच् comes after the verb गम् 'to go' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix and when the word to be formed denotes a name.

3.2.48.v: And the affix ड comes after the verb गम् 'to go' when in composition with the verbs - 1. अन्त 'end' 2. अत्यन्त 'extreme' 3. अध्वम् 'road' 4. दूर 'far' 5. पार 'across' 6. सर्व 'all' 7. अनन्त 'endless'.

3.2.49.v: The affix ड comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it and when benediction is intended.

3.2.50.v: The affix ड comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when it is compounded with the preposition अप् and when the object in composition with it, is the word क्लेश 'pain' or तमस् 'darkness'.

3.2.51.v: The affix णिनि comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the word in composition with it is कुमार 'a child' or शीर्ष 'head'.

3.2.52.v: The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when it is in composition with the word जाया 'wife' or पति 'husband' as object and when the word so formed denotes the agent possessed of that attribute (or when the word so formed denotes a mark).

3.2.53.v: The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it and when the word to be formed denotes an agent other than a human being.

3.2.54.v: The affix टक् comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it as its object is हस्ति 'elephant' or कपाट 'gate' and when the sense indicated is that of power.

3.2.55.v: The word पाणिघ and ताडघ are irregularly formed when denoting an artificier.

3.2.56.v: The affix ख्युन् , when in the sense of the word to be formed is that of an instrumental agent, comes after the verb कृ 'to make', when the following words are in composition with it - 1. आढ्य 'rich' 2. सुभग 'fortunate' 3. स्थूल 'big' 4. पलित 'grey' 5. नग्न 'naked' 6. अन्ध 'blind' 7. प्रिय 'pleasant', provided these words formed by the affix च्वि though not actually ending in the affix च्वि।

3.2.57.v: The affixes खिष्णुच् and खकञ् , when the word to be formed denotes an agent comes after the verb भू 'to become', when it is in composition with the words formed by the affix च्वि though not actually ending in the affix च्वि।

3.2.58.v: The affix क्विन् comes after the verb स्पृश् 'to touch' when it is in composition with a case-inflected word other than उदक 'water'.

3.2.59.v: The words - 1. ऋत्विक् 'a domestic priest' 2. दधृक् 'impudent' 3. स्रक् 'a garland' 4. दिक् 'direction' and 5. उष्णिक् 'a quatrain', are irregularly formed by adding the affix क्विन् and also after the verbs 6. अञ्चु 'to worship' 7. युजि 'to join' 8. क्रुञ्चु 'to approach', the affix क्विन् is used.
3.2.59.e: The words - ऋत्विक्, दधृष्, स्रज् , दिश्, उष्णिह् - are considered to be readymade forms made using the क्विन् प्रत्यय. Also, the verb अञ्च् gets the क्विन् प्रत्यय in presence of an उपपद, where as the verbs युज् and  क्रुञ्च् get the क्विन् प्रत्यय in absence of an उपपद.
3.2.59.sa: ऋत्विज् , दधृष्, स्रज् , दिश्, उष्णिह् - एते क्विन्-प्रत्ययान्तशब्दाः निपात्यन्ते । सोपपदस्य अञ्च्-धातोः , अनुपपदस्य युज्-क्रुञ्च्-धात्वोः च क्विन्-प्रत्ययः निपात्यते  ।
3.2.59.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.2.60.v: And the affix कञ् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' when it is in composition with त्यद् etc. and does not signify perception.

3.2.61.v: The affix क्विप्comes after the following verbs when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix, though it may be an उपसर्ग viz. 1. सत् 'to sit' 2. सू 'to bring forth' 3. द्विष् 'to hate' 4. द्रुह् 'to bear malice' 5. दुह् 'to milk' 6. युज् 'to join' , 'to concentrate the mind' 7. विद् 'to know', 'to consider' 8. भिद् 'to divide' 9. च्छिद् 'to cut' 10. जि 'to conquer' 11. नी 'to lead 12. राज् 'to shine'.

3.2.62.v: The affix ण्वि comes after the verb भज् 'to share' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix whether it be an उपसर्ग or not.

3.2.63.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix णिव comes after the verb सह् 'to bear' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix.

3.2.64.v: The affix णिव after the verb वह् 'to carry' in the छन्दस् (Vedas), when the word ending in case-affix is in composition with it.

3.2.65.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix ञ्युट् comes after the verb वह् 'to carry' when it is in composition with the words कव्य 'oblation of food to deceased ancestors', पुरीष 'faeces' and पुरीष्य 'water'.

3.2.66.v: The affix ञ्युट् comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb वह् 'to carry' when it is in composition with the word हव्य 'an oblation to gods', provided that the word so formed does not occur in the middle of a पाद (4th part of a stanza).

3.2.67.v: The affix विट् (the whole of which is elided) comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verbs 1. जन् 'to be born' 2. सन् 'to bestow' 3. खन् 'to dig' 4. क्रम् 'to pace' 5. गम् 'to go' when a word ending in case-affix is in composition and the final nasals are changed into long आ।

3.2.68.v: The affix विट् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when in composition with a case-inflected word other than अन्न 'food'.

3.2.69.v: The affix विट् comes after the verb अद् 'to eat' when the word क्रव्य is in composition with it.

3.2.70.v: The affix कप् comes after the verb दुह् 'to milk' when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix and the letter घ replaces the final.

3.2.71.v: In the मन्त्र literature,the affix णिवन् comes after the words 1. श्वेतवह 2.उक्थश 3. पुरोडाश् ।

3.2.72.v: In the मन्त्र literature,the affix णिवन् comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' when in composition the word अव्।

3.2.73.v: The affix विच् comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' when उप precedes it, in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

3.2.74.v: The affixes मनिन् (मन्), वनिप् (वन्), विनय (वन्) and विच् come in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verbs which end in long आ , when used in a case-inflected word or उपसर्ग in in composition.

3.2.75.v: These affixes i.e. - मनिन् (मन्), वनिप् (वन्), विनय (वन्) and विच् are seen after other verbs also besides those ending in long आ।

3.2.76.v: And the affix क्विप् is also seen after all verbs, whether having an उपपद or not in the Vedic as well as in the modern Sanskrit.

3.2.77.v: The affixes क and क्विप् come after the verb स्था when in composition with a word ending in a case-affix or an उपसर्ग ।

3.2.78.v: When habit is to be expressed, the affix णिनि comes after a verb, provided the word with a case-affix in composition with it does not mean a genus.

3.2.79.v: The affix णिनि comes after a verb when in composition with a word denoting an object of comparison, expressing the agent, the sense of the affix being 'doing something like that', that is to say, when the उपपद agent is the standard of comparison of the agent denoted by the word to which the sense of the affix refers.

3.2.80.v: The affix णिनि comes after a verb, in composition with a word ending in a case-affix.

3.2.81.v: The affix णिनि comes after a verb diversely when continued repitition of an action is to be expressed.

3.2.82.v: The affix णिनि comes after the verb मन् 'to think' when there is a word with a case-affix in composition with it.

3.2.83.v: And the affix णिनि comes after the verb मन् 'to think' when the word in composition with it is a word with a case-affix and when it is used to signify thought, whereof the object is self (the sense of the affix being 'thinking himself as such').

3.2.84.v: All the affixes to be treated of hereafter should be understood to come in the sense of past time.

3.2.85.v: The affix णिनि comes after the verb यज् 'to sacrifice' with the sense of past time, when the word in composition is the Instrumental -3rd case.

3.2.86.v: The affix णिनि comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time, when the word in composition is in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.87.v: The affix क्विप्comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time when the following words in the Accusative -2nd case ae in composition - 1. भ्रूण 'a foetus' 2. वृत्र ।

3.2.88.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix क्विप्diversely comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' with the sense of past time,ending with the word even when the word in composition with it is other than those mentioned in the last sūtra.

3.2.89.v: The affix क्विप्comes after the verb कृ 'to make' with the sense of past time, when the following words in the Accusative -2nd case are in composition - 1. सु 'action' 2. कर्म 'action' 3. पाप 'sin' 4. मन्त्र 'hymn' 5. पुण्य 'virtue'.

3.2.90.v: The affix क्विप्comes after the verb सु 'to press out juice' with the sense of past time, when the word सोम , in the Accusative -2nd case, is in composition.

3.2.91.v: The affix क्विप्comes after the verb चि 'to collect' with the sense of past time, when the word अग्नि , in the Accusative -2nd case, is in composition.

3.2.92.v: In expressing an object the affix क्विप्comes after the verb चि 'to collect' with the sense of past time when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case, provided the word so formed is the name of fire.

3.2.93.v: The affix इनि comes after the compound verb विकृ 'to sell' in the sense of past time, when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.94.v: The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verb दृश् 'to see' in the sense of past time, when in composition with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.95.v: The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verbs युध 'to fight' and कृ 'to make' with a past signification when the word राजन् 'king' is in composition, in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.96.v: The affix क्वनिप् comes after the verbs युध 'to fight' and कृ 'to make' with a past signification when the word सह 'with', is in composition.

3.2.97.v: The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the word, in composition with it is in the Locative -7th-case.

3.2.98.v: The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the word, in composition with it is in the Ablative -5th case, which does not denote a genus.

3.2.99.v: The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when an उपसर्ग is in composition and when the sense is simply appellative.

3.2.100.v: The affix ड comes after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification, when the root takes the preposition अनु and is compounded with a word in the Accusative -2nd case.

3.2.101.v: The affix ड is seen to come after the verb जन् 'to be produced', with a past signification,though it be in composition with other nouns, having cases other than those mentioned in the previous sūtras.

3.2.102.v: The affixes called निष्ठा come after a verbal root used in the sense of past time.

3.2.103.v: The affix ङ्वनिप् comes after the verbs सु 'to press out or extract juice' and यज् 'to sacrifice', with a past signification.

3.2.104.v: The affix अतृन् comes after the verb जृ 'to grow old' with the sense of past time.

3.2.105.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) comes after a verb with a past signification.

3.2.106.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) is optionally replaced by the affix कानच्।

3.2.107.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affix क्वसु is optionally the substitute for लिट् ।

3.2.108.v: In modern Sanskrit the affix क्वसु optionally replaces लिट् (Perfect Tense) after the verbs सद् , वस् and श्रु with a past signification.

3.2.109.v: The forms उपेयिवान् , नाश्वान् , नूचान् are irregularly formed.

3.2.110.v: The affix लुङ् (Aorist) comes after the verb in the sense of past time.
3.2.110.e: The लुङ्-प्रत्ययः is used to indicate the past tense.
3.2.110.sa: भूतकालं द्योतयितुम् धातोः परः आद्युदात्तः लुङ्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
3.2.110.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.2.111.v: The affix लुङ् (Aorist) comes after a verbal root used in the sense of past before the commencement of the current day.
3.2.111.e: लङ्-लकार is used to indicate actions that have happened yesterday or before.
3.2.111.sa: अनद्यतन-भूतकालं द्योतयितुम् धातोः परः लङ्-लकारः प्रयुज्यते ।
3.2.111.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.2.112.v: When a word implying 'recollection' is in connection with it, a verb takes the affix लृट् (2nd Future) in the sense of the past before the commencement of the present day.

3.2.113.v: The affix लृट् (2nd Future) is not applied in the sense of the past when the उपपद denoting recollection has in connection with it the particle यत्।

3.2.114.v: The affix लृट् (2nd Future) is optionally applied in the sense of the past, when a word implying 'recollection' is in connection with it and whether such a word has the particle यत् or is used simply; provided that the two verbs, occurring in the same complex sentence, are also connected together, that each is necessary to the other , to complete the sense of the speaker.

3.2.115.v: The affix लिट् (Perfect Tense) comes after the verb in the sense of the past before the commencement of the current day and unperceived by the narrator.
3.2.115.e: लिट्-लकार is used to indicate an action which was done yesterday or before and which was not seen by the speaker of the sentence.
3.2.115.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.2.116.v: And the affix लङ् (Imperfect Tense) comes after the verb when the particles ह and शश्वत are in connection with it and when the verb denotes past action unperceived by the speaker and before the commencement of the current day.

3.2.117.v: The affixes लङ् (Imperfect Tense) and लिट् (Perfect Tense) come after a verb (in expressing a past time not belonging to the current day and unperceived by the speaker) when the past referred to is recent and the sentence is interrogative.

3.2.118.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when the particle स्म is in connection with it (and denotes a past time not belonging to the current day and unperceived by the speaker). Note : This debars लिट् (Perfect Tense) .

3.2.119.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when the particle स्म is in connection with it and denotes a past action not belonging to the current day and when the action is perceived by the agent.

3.2.120.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) is used after a verb in denoting a past action when the word ननु is in connection with it and an answer is given to the question.

3.2.121.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes optionally after a verb in denoting past time, in reply to an interrogation, when the words न 'not' and नु 'what of that' are in connection with it.

3.2.122.v: Optionally the affixes लुङ् (Aorist) and लट् (Present Tense) come after a verb in denoting past time not belonging to the current day, when the word पुरा is used in the sentence, provided that the word स्म is not used.

3.2.123.v: The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when denoting a present action.
3.2.123.sa: वर्तमानस्य अर्थे धातोः परः लट्-प्रत्ययः भवति ।
3.2.123.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.2.124.v: The affixes शतृ and शानच् are substitutes of लट् (Present Tense) when agreeing with what does not end with the 1st (Nominative Case) case-affix.
3.2.124.e: The लट्-लकार gets शतृ and शानच् as आदेशाः to denote the present-tense, provided a विभक्ति other than प्रथमा is used along with these.
3.2.124.sa: वर्तमानार्थे प्रथमाभिन्नविभक्तेः विषये लट्-लकारस्य शतृ-शानच्-आदेशौ भवतः ।
3.2.124.m: Vasu's notes and the Sanskrit explanation

3.2.125.v: The affixes शतृ and शानच् are substitutes of लट् (Present Tense) even when agreeing with what ends with a 1st (Nominative Case) case-affix, provided that it is in the Vocative Case.

3.2.126.v: The affixes शतृ and शानच् are substitutes of लट् (Present Tense) and come after a verb in expressing an attendant circumstance or characteristic and the cause of an action.

3.2.127.v: These two - शतृ and शानच् are called सत्.

3.2.128.v: The affix शानन् comes after the verbs पू 'to purify' and यज् 'to sacrifice'.

3.2.129.v: The affix चानश् comes after a verb in expressing 'habit', standard of age' and 'inability'.

3.2.130.v: The affix शतृ comes after the verb इङ् 'to go' and धारि 'to hold' in denoting that the agent does the action without trouble.

3.2.131.v: The affix शतृ comes after the verb द्विष् when the agent indicated means 'an enemy'.

3.2.132.v: The affix शतृ comes after the verb सु 'to press out or extract juice' when the sense is that of association with sacrifice.

3.2.133.v: The affix शतृ comes after the verb अर्ह in expressing praise.

3.2.134.v: From this sūtra as far as क्विप् in sūtra [[3.4.177]] (inclusive), the affixes that we shall treat of, are to be understood in the sense of agents having such a habit or nature or having skill in such and such action.

3.2.135.v: The affix तृन् comes after all verbs in the sense of 'agents having such a habit etc.'.

3.2.136.v: The affix इष्णुच् comes after following verbs in the sense of 'agents having such a habit etc.' - 1. अलंकृ 'to adorn' 2. ञ्निराकृ 'to expel' 3. प्रजन् 'to be born' 4. उत्पच् 'to be ripe' 5. उत्पत् 'to fly' 6. उन्मद् 'to be mad' 7. रुच् 'to shine' 8. अपत्रप् 'to be ashamed' 9. वृत् 'to move' 10. वृध् 'to grow 12. सह 'to bear' 13. चर् 'to walk'.

3.2.137.v: The affix इष्णुच् in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb that ends in the causative णि।

3.2.138.v: The affix इष्णुच् in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the verb भू 'to be' etc.

3.2.139.v: The affix क्स्नु comes after the following verbs in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' viz. - 1. ग्ला 'to be weary' 2. जि 'to conquer' 3. स्था 'to stand', as well as after भू 'to be'.

3.2.140.v: The affix क्नु comes after the verbs - 1. त्रस् 'to tremble' 2. गृध् 'to be greedy' 3. धृष् 'to be bold' 4. क्षिप् 'to throw' in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.'.

3.2.141.v: The affix घिनुण् comes after the 8 verbs beginning with शम् 'to be calm' in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.'.

3.2.142.v: The affix घिनुण् comes after the following verbs in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.'. - 1. संपृच् 2. अनुरुध् 3. आङ्यम् 4. आङ्यस् 5. परिसृ 6. संसृज् 7. परिदेवि 8. संज्वर् 9. परिक्षिप् 10. परिरट् 11. परिवद् 12. परिदह् 13. परिमुह् 14. दुष् 15. द्विष् 16. द्रुह् 17. दुह् 18. युज् 19. आक्रीड् 20. विविच् 21. त्यज् 22. रज् 23. भज् 24 अतिचर् 25. अपचर् 26. आमुष् 27. अभ्याहन्।

3.2.143.v: The affix घिनुण् comes after the verbs कष् 'to injure', लस् 'to embrace and sport', कत्थ 'to praise' and स्रम्भ 'to believe', when these are in composition with the preposition वि।

3.2.144.v: The affix घिनुण् comes after the verb लष 'to wish' when compounded with the preposition अप and वि।

3.2.145.v: The affix घिनुण् comes after the verbs 1. लप् 2. सृ 3. द्रु 4. मथ 5. वद् 6. वस् when compounded with the preposition वि।

3.2.146.v: The affix वुञ् is added to the following verbs in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' - 1. निन्द् 2. हिंस् 3. क्लिश् 4. खाद् 5. विनाश् 6. परिक्षिप् 7. परिरट् 8. व्याभाष् and असूय।

3.2.147.v: The affix वुञ् comes after the verbs देवि 'to lament' and क्रुश 'to cry' when an उपसर्ग is in composition with them.

3.2.148.v: The affix युच् comes, in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' after intransitive verbs denoting 'motion' or 'sound'.

3.2.149.v: The affix युच् comes, in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' after intransitive verbs as are आत्मनेपदि and begin with a consonant and are अनुदात्त i.e. have a gravely accented vowel as as indicatory.

3.2.150.v: The affix युच् comes after the following verbs in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' - 1. जु 2. चङ्क्रम्य 3. दन्द्रम्य 4. सृ 5. गृध 6.ज्वल 7. शुच 8. लष 9. पत 10. पद।

3.2.151.v: And after the verbs having the sense of क्रुध् 'to be angry' and मण्ड 'to adorn', the affix युच् is used.

3.2.152.v: The affix युच् is not used after the verbs which end in the letter य।

3.2.153.v: The affix युच् does not come after the verbs सूद् 'to strike', दीप् 'to shine' and दीक्ष् 'to initiate'.

3.2.154.v: The affix उकञ् comes after the following verbs, in the sense of 'agent having such habit etc.' - 1. लष् 2. पत् 3. पद् 4. स्था 5. भू 6. वृष् 7. हन् 8. कम् 9. गम् 10. शॄ ।

3.2.155.v: The affix षाकन् comes, in the sense of 'agent having such habit etc.' after the following verbs - 1. जल्प् 2. भिक्ष् 3. कुट्ट 4. लुण्ट 5.वृङ ।

3.2.156.v: The affix इनि comes in the sense of 'agent having such habit etc.' after the verb प्रजु 'to hasten forward'.

3.2.157.v: The affix इनि comes in the sense of 'agent having such habit etc.' after the verbs 1. जि 'to conquer' 2. दृ 'to respect' 3. क्षि 'to waste, to dwell, to go' 4. विश्रि 'to shelter' 5. इ 'to go' 6. वम् 'to vomit' 7. अव्यथ 'not to give pain' 8. अभ्यम 'to injure' 9. परिभू 'to humiliate' 10. प्रसू 'to beget'.

3.2.158.v: The affix आलुच् comes in the sense of 'agent having such habit etc.' after the words - 1. स्पृह् 'to desire' 2. गृह् 'to seize' 3. पत् 'to go' 4. दय् 'to give, to go , to protect' 5. निद्रा 'to sleep' 6. तन्द्रा 'to be tired' 7. श्रद्धा 'to venerate'.

3.2.159.v: The affix रु comes after the verbs 1. दा 'to give' 2. धेट् 'to suck' 3. सि 'to bind' 4. शद 'to fall' 5. सद् 'to sit'.

3.2.160.v: The affix क्मरच् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' comes after the verbs 1. सृ 'to flow' 2. घसि 'to eat' 3. अद् 'to eat'.

3.2.161.v: The affix घुरच् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. भञ्ज् 'to break' 2. भास् 'to shine' 3. भिद् 'to be fat'.

3.2.162.v: The affix कुरच् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. विद् 'to know' 2. भिद् 'to divide' 3. छिद् 'to pierce'.

3.2.163.v: The affix क्वरप् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. इ 'to go' 2. नश् 'to destroy' 3. जि 'to conquer' 4. सृ 'to flow'.

3.2.164.v: And the word गत्वर is irregularly formed.

3.2.165.v: The affix ऊक comes after the verb जागृ 'to be awake' in the sense of 'agent having such a habit'.

3.2.166.v: The affix ऊक comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. यज् 2. जप् 3. दश् when they end in the affix य्।

3.2.167.v: The affix र comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. नम 'to bow' 2. क्मप् 'to shake' 3. स्मि 'to smile' 4. अजस् 'not to cease' 5. कम 'to desire' 6. हिंस 'to injure' 7. दीप 'to shine'.

3.2.168.v: The affix उ comes after the roots that have taken the affix सन् and after all the verbs आशंस् 'to wish' and भिक्ष 'to beg' in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.'.

3.2.169.v: The words विन्दु and इच्छु are irregularly formed by the addition of the affix उ , in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.'.

3.2.170.v: The affix उ comes in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the roots that have taken the Denominative affix क्य in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.'.

3.2.171.v: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the affixes कि and किन् in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' come after the verbs that end in long आ or long or short ऋ and after the verbs 1. गम् 'to go' 2. हन् 'to kill' 3. जन् 'to be produced' and these affixes operate like लिट् (Perfect Tense) causing reduplication of the root.

3.2.172.v: The affix नजिङ् comes, in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs स्वप् 'to sleep' and तृष् 'to be thirsty'.

3.2.173.v: The affix आरु comes, in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs शॄ 'to to injure' and वन्द् 'to praise, to salute'.

3.2.174.v: The affixes क्रु and क्लुकन come in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verb भी 'to fear'.

3.2.175.v: The affix वरच् comes, in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. स्था 'to stand' 2. ईश 'to rule' 3. भास् 'to shine' 4. पिस् 'to go' 5. कस् 'to go'.

3.2.176.v: The affix वरच् in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' comes after the verb या when it ends with the affix यङ्।

3.2.177.v: The affix क्विप् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. भ्राज 'to shine' 2. भास् 'to shine' 3. धुर्व 'to injure' 4. द्युत् 'to shine' 5. ऊर्ज 'to be strong' 6. पॄ 'to fill' 7. जु 'to move rapidly' 8. स्तु 'to praise', when preceded by the word ग्रवन् 'a stone'.

3.2.178.v: The affix क्विप् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs other than those seen above.

3.2.179.v: The affix क्विप् comes after the verb भू 'to be' when the word so formed denotes a name or surety.

3.2.180.v: The affix डु comes after the verb भू 'to be' when it is preceded by the उपसर्ग वि , प्र and सम् provided that the word to be formed does not mean an appellative.

3.2.181.v: The affix ष्ट्रन् comes, in denoting the object after the verb धा 'to feed'.

3.2.182.v: The affix ष्ट्रन् with in the sense of instrument, comes after the verbs 1. दाप 'to cut' 2. नी 'to lead' 3. शस् 'to hurt' 4. यु 'to join' 5. युज् 'to join' 6. स्तु 'to praise' 7. तुद् 'to inflict pain' 8. सि 'to bind' 9. सिच् 'to sprinkle' 10. मिह् 'to urine' 11. पत् 'to fall' 12. दश् 'to bite' 13. नह् 'to bind'

3.2.183.v: The affix ष्ट्रन् is used after the verb पू 'to purify' with the sense of instrument when denoting a member of the body of a plough or of a hog.

3.2.184.v: The affix इत्र comes after the verbs 1. ऋ 'to go' 2. लू 'to cut' 3. धू 'to shake' 4. सू 'to bring forth' 5. खन् 'to dig' 6. सह् 'to bear' 7. चर् 'to go' , with the sense of instrument.

3.2.185.v: The affix इत्र comes after the verb पू 'to purify' with the sense of the agent so expressed being the instrument when the sense of the complete word is simply appellative and not descriptive.

3.2.186.v: The affix इत्र comes after the verb पू 'to purify' with the sense of the agent or instrument when it is respectively used in connection with a sage or a deity.

3.2.187.v: The verbal roots marked with an indicatory ञि , take the affix क्त , in denoting the present time.

3.2.188.v: And after the roots denoting inclination, understanding, or respect, the affix क्त is used with the force of the present
